name: MWFOLK1-no-picture-wears-its-outfit
note: Every walker dressed by the wardrobe again: the eleven outfits made for their pictures never worn.

name: MWFOLK1-a-woman-in-a-mans-picture
note: A woman walking on a man's sprite wears his tunic and hose, made for a man's body.

name: MWFOLK1-boots-on-a-beast
note: A Khajiit or an Argonian resident on an outfit's sprite wears its boots, which Morrowind puts on no beast's feet.

name: MWFOLK1-every-picture-a-mans
note: The hooded Redguard woman's picture read as a man's: she never wears her dress.

name: MWFOLK1-the-sleeves-hide-no-forearm
note: 385's long sleeve closes round the forearm and the skin under it still stands - a forearm through the sleeve wherever it is snug.

name: MWFOLK1-a-hood-over-the-hair
note: The green hood drawn over the hair: whatever hair the face walked to stands through it.

name: MWFOLK1-the-bodice-covers-nothing
note: The hooded woman's open bodice read as no chest covered: the modesty weld puts a shirt under her dress.

name: MWFOLK1-any-id-an-outfit
old: for (const o of Object.values(TOWNSFOLK_OUTFITS)) if (o.id === id) return o;
new: for (const o of Object.values(TOWNSFOLK_OUTFITS)) return o;
note: An id the table does not hold - relay data - dresses its body in the first outfit.

name: MWFOLK1-the-outfit-never-added
note: The outfit hides the skin it covers and draws nothing over it: a body with holes for a tunic.

name: MWFOLK1-the-second-outfit-drawn
old: if (outfitAdd) { notes.push(`outfit ${o.id}: ${t('body.outfit.second', 'a second outfit - the first ({first}) is the one drawn', { first: outfitAdd.recordId })}`); continue; }
note: A second outfit replaces the first without a word, its hides added to the first's.

name: MWFOLK1-hidden-in-the-first-person
old: for (const h of o.hides) claim(ARMO_PART.findIndex((r) => r.name === h), prio, null, outfitAdd);
new: for (const h of o.hides) claim(ARMO_PART.findIndex((r) => r.name === h), prio, null);
note: The outfit's hides are the first person's too, which draws no outfit: holes where the arm should be.

name: MWFOLK1-a-shirt-under-the-dress
note: The modesty weld blind to an outfit's covers: a shirt composed under the hooded woman's bodice.

name: MWFOLK1-the-wolf-in-a-tunic
note: A werewolf's body asked to wear its person's outfit over the robe.

name: MWFOLK1-one-body-two-outfits
note: The body key blind to the outfit: a walker re-rolled from one sprite to another keeps the last one's clothes.

name: MWFOLK1-a-hood-is-no-cap
old: const capsHead = (a) => a.partName === 'head' || a.partName === 'hair' || (a.hides ?? []).some((h) => h === 'head' || h === 'hair');
note: A hood that drew is not read as covering the hair: the hair is assembled again through it.

name: MWFOLK1-every-outfit-one-key
note: Every outfit one equip key: a body that changed outfits is never rebuilt.

name: MWFOLK1-the-card-calls-it-armour
old: : p.kind === 'outfit' ? `outfit ${p.id}`   // MW-FOLK1: a townsperson's whole outfit
new: : p.kind === 'never' ? `outfit ${p.id}`   // MW-FOLK1: a townsperson's whole outfit
note: The paperdoll card names an outfit 'armor undefined' and finds no reason for one that did not draw.

name: MWFOLK1-the-note-says-helm
old: missing.push(`${cap?.partName === 'outfit' ? cap.slot : 'helm'}: none of it bound
note: A hood that bound nothing reported as a helm.

name: MWFOLK1-the-arm-falls-at-the-old-angle
old: const want = Math.asin(PACK_ARM_FALL / Math.hypot(H[0] - U[0], H[2] - U[2]));
note: The arm's turn read off its run alone: the wrist 0.505 under the shoulder, not PACK_ARM_FALL.

name: MWFOLK1-retails-clavicle-kept
note: The clavicle left at retail's fall: every sleeve bound 3 units over the arm it animates.

name: MWFOLK1-the-hoods-not-raised
note: The hoods where the T-posed scene's head was: the game's scalp stands through them.

name: MWFOLK1-a-hood-read-as-a-collar
note: A hood classed as the torso's: weighted to the spine, it stays behind when the head turns.

name: MWFOLK1-the-teal-hood-green
note: 389 in 388's green: two sprites, one outfit, the teal his picture wears lost.

name: MWFOLK1-the-cut-edge-lost
note: An edge a cut polygon shared with one that stays dropped with it: the polygon left is missing an edge.

name: MWFOLK1-the-cut-vertices-kept
old: const usedV = [...new Set(keptPV.map(vOf))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
new: const usedV = Array.from({ length: verts.length / 3 }, (_, i) => i);
note: A cut that keeps every vertex: the groin's points still in the file, used by nothing.

name: MWFOLK1-a-whole-object-cut
old: throw new Error(mats[0] === material ? `${label}: every polygon wears material ${material} - drop the object instead` : `${label}: no polygon wears material ${material} - nothing to cut`);
new: throw new Error(`${label}: no polygon wears material ${material} - nothing to cut`);
note: A cut of an object's only material told it has nothing to cut, when the object itself should go.
